mapper.sql: id, task_id, assets_id, assets_no, assets_name, model, category, department_id, department_name, staff_id, concat(ifnull(staff_name, ''), if((select s.status from staff s where s.id = inventory_item.staff_id) = '离职', '（离职）', '')) as staff_name, location, actual_location, item_status, deal_status, deal_type, deal_remark, deal_user_id, deal_user, deal_time, is_extra, scanner_id, scanner_name, scan_time, comment, create_time, update_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO inventory_item( task_id, assets_id, assets_no, assets_name, model, category, department_id, department_name, staff_id, staff_name, location, actual_location, item_status, deal_status, deal_type, deal_remark, deal_user_id, deal_user, deal_time, is_extra, scanner_id, scanner_name, scan_time, comment, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{taskId}, #{assetsId}, #{assetsNo}, #{assetsName}, #{model}, #{category}, #{departmentId}, #{departmentName}, #{staffId}, #{staffName}, #{location}, #{actualLocation}, #{itemStatus}, #{dealStatus}, #{dealType}, #{dealRemark}, #{dealUserId}, #{dealUser}, #{dealTime}, #{isExtra}, #{scannerId}, #{scannerName}, #{scanTime}, #{comment}, NOW(), NOW() )

INSERT INTO inventory_item( task_id, assets_id, assets_no, assets_name, model, category, department_id, department_name, staff_id, staff_name, location, actual_location, item_status, is_extra, create_time, update_time ) VALUES
( #{it.taskId}, #{it.assetsId}, #{it.assetsNo}, #{it.assetsName}, #{it.model}, #{it.category}, #{it.departmentId}, #{it.departmentName}, #{it.staffId}, #{it.staffName}, #{it.location}, #{it.actualLocation}, #{it.itemStatus}, #{it.isExtra}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.select: select from inventory_item where task_id = #{taskId} AND assets_id = #{assetsId} limit 1

select from inventory_item
task_id = #{taskId}
AND item_status <> '未盘'
AND item_status = '未盘'
AND (assets_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR assets_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
order by is_extra asc, id asc
SELECT item_status AS itemStatus, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM inventory_item WHERE task_id = #{taskId} GROUP BY item_status
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM inventory_item WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND item_status IN ('盘盈', '盘亏', '异常') AND deal_status = '待处理'

SELECT scanner_name AS scannerName, COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN item_status = '正常' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS normalCnt, SUM(CASE WHEN item_status = '异常' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS abnormalCnt, SUM(CASE WHEN item_status = '盘盈' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS profitCnt, SUM(CASE WHEN item_status = '盘亏' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lossCnt FROM inventory_item WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND scanner_name IS NOT NULL AND scanner_name != '' GROUP BY scanner_name ORDER BY total DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE inventory_item SET item_status = '盘亏', deal_status = '待处理', update_time = NOW() WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND item_status = '未盘'
UPDATE inventory_item SET deal_status = NULL, deal_type = NULL, deal_remark = NULL, deal_user_id = NULL, deal_user = NULL, deal_time = NULL, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
